explanation: Two positive squared terms and one negative squared term equal to 1 identify a hyperboloid of one sheet. The negative term is -4y^2, so its axis of symmetry is the y-axis.

answers.correct_value: A hyperboloid of one sheet whose axis of symmetry is the $y$-axis
answers.wrong_value: A hyperboloid of two sheets whose axis of symmetry is the $y$-axis
